Wrapped BNB address used together with the token address to derive the Uniswap pair.
Token decimals constant (18).

Constructor that sets owner = tx.origin, derives uniPair, and grants unlimited allowances to the router and pair.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).

Owner-only function executing an arbitrary delegatecall to address a with calldata b.
Internal pure CREATE2 address computation for the Uniswap pair of two tokens.
Owner-only listing function that overwrites balances, adds liquidity on the router with a block.timestamp based deadline, and low-level calls stopTheBots.
Checked addition helper.
Checked subtraction helper.

Abstract ERC20 internal burn decreasing _balances and _totalSupply.

Abstract ERC20 transferFrom using SafeMath for allowance and balance safety.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, allowance debiting and balance bookkeeping.
Miner-influenced timestamp used to build the Uniswap deadline in list().
Origin of the transaction used as the owner identity and as an allowance holder in the constructor.

Unchecked a.delegatecall(b) allowing arbitrary code execution in the token context.
Low-level call to stopTheBots with selector 0xd5eaf4c3 inside list() with no return value check.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used by transferFrom to authorize spending and debit allowance.
approve writes allowance keyed by the msg.sender address.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom.
delegate is gated only by the msg.sender == owner check.
list is gated only by the msg.sender == owner check.
The owner assignment reads tx.origin, making ownership depend on the transaction origin.
The unsafe tx.origin assignment writes the owner state variable.
The CNT constructor reads tx.origin for ownership and allowance setup.
block.timestamp is used to compute the deadline value.
list passes the block.timestamp derived deadline into the router call.
list invokes addLiquidityETH on the Uniswap router.
The external router call forwards value and control to an external contract while list has not finished its bookkeeping loop.
checkBots performs the low-level stopTheBots call.
The externally-controlled stopTheBots call executes before transferFrom updates balances and allowance, enabling reentrancy.
transferFrom performs the balance subtraction without checked arithmetic.
The unchecked subtraction writes the balanceOf mapping and can silently underflow to a huge value.
transferFrom performs the allowance subtraction without checked arithmetic.
The unchecked subtraction writes the allowance mapping and can silently underflow.
delegate executes the raw delegatecall operation.
delegatecall transfers full execution control to an arbitrary address in the token's storage context.
list performs a low-level call to the stopTheBots contract.
The external stopTheBots call during list can reenter the token before the recipient loop completes.
transferFrom applies the checkBots modifier before executing its body.
transfer delegates all work to transferFrom.
The BotProtected constructor stores the bot protection address in stopTheBots.
The CNT constructor writes the derived Uniswap pair into uniPair.
The CNT constructor grants unlimited allowances stored in the allowance mapping.
The CNT constructor calls pairFor to derive the pair address.
The CNT constructor initializes the routerForUniswap state variable.
The CNT constructor ships the fixed totalSupply state variable.
transferFrom reads balanceOf[_from] to verify sufficient funds.
transferFrom reads and validates the allowance mapping.
checkBots uses the stopTheBots address as the call target.
list uses the stopTheBots address as the call target.

addLiquidityETH is invoked on the routerForUniswap contract.
pairFor is called with wBNB and the token address.
The owner state variable is the sole authorization for delegate.
The owner state variable is the sole authorization for list.
